data_product_overview:
## About this dashboard
Providers prescribing accounts for a significant proportion of NHS expenditure, particularly where prescriptions issued by hospital clinicians are dispensed in the community. The Hospital Trust Volume & Cost Report in ePACT2 provides authorised users with detailed insights into the volume and cost of all items prescribed by a Provider and subsequently processed by NHS Prescription Services.

This report enables trusts to monitor prescribing activity across their organisation, identify high-cost medicines, and review trends over time. Users can filter data by month and cost centre, allowing for granular analysis of prescribing behaviour and associated financial impact. The report also supports export functionality, enabling integration with other systems such as Define for further analysis.

The aim of this report is to provide transparency and accountability in Provider prescribing, supporting financial governance and medicines optimisation. It helps trusts understand which units or departments are driving costs and whether prescribing aligns with clinical and commissioning guidance. While the report offers detailed financial and prescribing data, it should be used alongside other dashboards and clinical information to inform decisions. Its intention is to generate discussion within Providers, identify areas for improvement, and share best practice across organisations.
